findings.issue: The cylinder fundamental group (AddCircle p × Y, concretely S¹ × ℝ) is new content but is not a Stage 4 roadmap target. Stage 4 applications enumerate only π_n(S¹)=0, π₁(S¹)≅ℤ, and π_n(Tᵏ)/π₁(RPⁿ)/K(G,1) (TauCetiRoadmap/UniversalCovers/README.md:139-145); 'cylinder' appears nowhere in the UniversalCovers roadmap. The cylinder is a leaf example on no proximate path to any named target (it is not the torus, and nothing builds on it toward RPⁿ/K(G,1)), and is justified as 'the canonical example' — i.e. as interesting.

summary: The generalization lemma (simply-connected collapse of the merged product formula) is in scope, but the PR's actual deliverable — the new file computing π₁ of a cylinder — is not a named Stage 4 target and lies on no proximate path to the enumerated targets (Tᵏ, RPⁿ, K(G,1)); it is presented as a canonical example. A human must add the cylinder to the UniversalCovers roadmap first.
